Akhilesh Yadav Alleges Pressure on Honest Officers, Cites IAS Officer's Resignation

Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav alleged that honest government officials are being forced to resign under the current BJP government. He specifically cited the resignation of IAS officer Divya Mittal, claiming she was pressured. Yadav also mentioned meeting with individuals named Mohit and Digvijay Bhati, and referred to SSP Avinash Pandey in connection with the controversy. The coverage indicates Yadav met with Mohit Jatav and Digvijay Bhati in Meerut.
